First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2}
Status: Active
Affiliation: Independent (magical consultants to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} through @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane})

Description

Three halfling sisters — Aurea, Venn, and Delta — who are triplet hedge-wizards practicing a strange geometric art based on mathematical principles.
They are not aligned with the Wizard's College and operate as independent practitioners from @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum}.

Aurea wears gold and is inspired by the Golden Ratio.
She focuses on proportional harmony, alignment, symmetry, and long-term stability.
She serves as the de facto leader and primary spokesperson, though they all claim equal standing.
She speaks in mathematical metaphors about balance and proportion.

Venn wears violet and silver with overlapping blue.
She is obsessed with intersections, overlaps, shared spaces, and boundaries — like a Venn diagram.
She focuses on things that exist between other things.

Delta is focused on change, transformation, differentiation, deviations, and thresholds.
She contributed the key insight about ruin and renewal being counterparts among the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{Old Gods}.

Role

The Triune serve as magical consultants and researchers operating from the Nodrum.
They have an arrangement with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} through @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane}, providing magical expertise in exchange for autonomy.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} previously consulted them about @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor}'s curse but kept the druid's true identity secret because their curiosity seemed too eager.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} - Old acquaintance; Aurea greeted him warmly as a friend
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} - Serve as magical consultants through @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} - Secretly siphoned energy from his curse to power the Aegis Mechanism

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2} - Examined @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric} with geometric devices that seized on contact; confessed to siphoning @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor}'s curse energy to power @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.03mz8edEPYw7i0UL]{The Xan-Kor}; helped the party redirect ley line energy into the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{Whiteglass} seal; declared the party were the heralds of ruin; directed them toward a shrine to the God of Renewal beneath the Chryseum in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2}
